role: Post-hoc diagnostic declared after the matched coverage results; not an independent test.
question: Do off-target mask fragments contribute to false partial judgments on complete lines?
model: Fixed coverage_predicted final state head; no training or threshold changes.
rule: Use the largest four-connected component of the existing thresholded target/ink intersection, the same connectivity rule previously used for box decoding; retain the component mask, not its box.
evaluation: All 317 previous and 441 fresh development cases; same inputs except predicted mask filtering. Current-only fixed upper-region masks unchanged. No oracle masks or labels used for filtering.
metrics: All original metrics and paired repairs/regressions, with full 97% stress results retained. No selection among alternative connectivity rules.
